tip: sein plus a past participle names a resulting state, not an action: Die Tür ist geschlossen means it stands closed now.
In the perfect passive, werden becomes worden, not geworden: ist saniert worden means has been renovated.
In a passive, durch names the means or cause, not the doer: durch einen Fußball zerbrochen means broken by a football.
In a passive, von plus dative names the doer: von einem bekannten Künstler gemalt means painted by a famous artist.
A modal plus participle plus werden makes a passive obligation: muss ausgetauscht werden means must be replaced.
A passive can have no real subject; es fills the slot: es darf nicht gegrillt werden means grilling is not allowed.
After etwas, nichts or alles the relative pronoun is was, not das: etwas, was mich überrascht hat means something that surprised me.
deren is the relative pronoun for whose with feminine and plural nouns: die Kollegin, deren Idee means the colleague whose idea.
Drop wenn and put the verb first to form an if-clause: Hätte ich das gewusst means if I had known that.
